full_name: Lillian Polanco-Roman | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2024–2025 Biological Sciences Mary I. Bunting Institute Fellow The New School
bio: Lillian Polanco-Roman is a licensed clinical psychologist and a Robert Wood Johnson Foundation Health Equity Scholar whose research focuses on the developmental and mental health consequences of racism and discrimination experiences.
